Update the prompt for a recorded select_item step and re-extract

Source: R/items.R
update_item.Rd

Update the prompt for a recorded select_item step and re-extract

Usage

update_item(
  sess,
  label,
  prompt = NULL,
  cast = NULL,
  chat = NULL,
  re_extract = TRUE
)

Arguments

sess

A macrox_session object.

label

Label of the item to update.

prompt

New prompt string.

cast

New cast type, or NULL to keep existing.

chat

An existing ellmer Chat object to use for the re-extraction. See select_table_llm(). NULL (default) reuses the provider/model recorded for the step.

re_extract

Re-run the LLM call immediately (default TRUE).

Value

sess invisibly.
